prompt: Ultra-photorealistic high-end editorial street-style portrait of a beautiful young adult woman in Paris, standing just outside an elegant classic French café on a charming Haussmannian street. She is captured in a confident, alluring yet sophisticated pose: her body angled three-quarters away from the camera, one shoulder slightly raised, one hand gently resting on the café doorway or railing, while she turns her head back toward the camera with a poised, self-assured expression and a subtle closed-mouth smile. Her posture is graceful and naturally feminine, creating an effortlessly bold fashion-editorial presence without looking staged. She has long, voluminous dark-brown hair with natural soft waves cascading down her back, styled in a loose half-up hairstyle with delicate curtain bangs framing her face and a refined tortoiseshell hair clip. Realistic individual hair strands, subtle flyaways, natural movement and texture. Refined facial features, expressive dark-brown eyes, naturally defined brows, soft luminous skin with visible realistic texture, warm rosy lips, subtle blush and elegant natural makeup. No excessive retouching or artificial beauty-filter effect. She wears a striking, sophisticated Parisian-inspired outfit: an elegant ivory silk blouse with delicate floral embroidery, a refined square neckline, softly structured puff sleeves and subtle draping, paired with a high-waisted tailored black midi skirt with a sleek feminine silhouette and a tasteful side slit. The outfit feels luxurious, confident and fashion-forward while remaining classy and timeless. Add delicate gold hoop earrings, a slim gold bracelet, understated rings and a structured dark-brown leather shoulder bag with premium textured leather and elegant hardware. Authentic Parisian environment: grand cream limestone Haussmann buildings, ornate wrought-iron balconies, classic black street lamps, elegant French café façade, striped café awnings, small round outdoor tables, vintage chairs, bicycles parked along the sidewalk, subtle flower arrangements, casually dressed pedestrians and a French flag softly visible in the distance. Warm café interior lights glowing naturally through the windows, adding depth and atmosphere. Composition: vertical 4:5 portrait, medium-to-medium-full body framing, camera positioned slightly behind and at eye level, subject occupying the visual center while maintaining enough environmental context to establish Paris. Natural candid street-photography composition, elegant leading lines from the architecture and café entrance, realistic human proportions, authentic perspective. Lighting: soft diffused Parisian afternoon daylight under slightly overcast skies, gentle highlights on her hair and face, subtle warm reflections from the café windows, realistic soft shadows, balanced exposure, delicate cinematic separation between subject and background. Photography: luxury fashion editorial meets authentic candid Pari
